report: attempt-005 fix: independent review of the ARM64 kc-tools producer fix and control KC (addendum to attempt005-independent-analysis.json)
verdict: APPROVE: the fix is minimal and correct. The control KC differs from the failing KC only in the two __TEXT.vmsize fields (0x330000 -> 0x17c000), and no 2048-phase permission conflict remains. Not a boot claim.

checks.detail: nix-store --references of the old vs new KC drv differ in exactly one entry: kc-tools-0.1.drv (2hgpc78h) replaced by kc-tools-arm64-text-fixed-0.1.drv (1xv1a2vn). Kernel, kexts, recipe and sources are unchanged.

src/fileset.c:1008 adds 'omh->cputype != CPU_TYPE_ARM64 &&' to the embedded-kernel __TEXT inflation, so RISCV64 and other architectures keep their layout. The comment is accurate. The fileset.c:651-666 __DATA_CONST-over-__LASTDATA_CONST extension is untouched (control KC __DATA_CONST vmsize is still 0x1b4000), which is benign for permissions per the original analysis.

checks.check: byte diff old vs control KC
checks.detail: Same size (38883200 bytes). Exactly 4 differing bytes: top-level header __TEXT.vmsize (file offset 0x41..0x42) and com.apple.kernel member __TEXT.vmsize (0x4041..0x4042), both 0x330000 -> 0x17c000. No other load-command field, UUID, fixup or payload byte changed.
Control KC kernel __TEXT = 0xfffffe0007004000 + 0x17c000, ending at 0xfffffe0007180000 = __DATA_CONST start (no overlap). Equals the linker's __TEXT vmsize and filesize in kernel.debug.t8103.

Segment values parsed from each KC. Old: 1232 phases with PERMISSION conflicts (hinted RO __TEXT vs unhinted RW __DATA_CONST/__LASTDATA_CONST) plus 144 hint-only. Control: 0 permission conflicts; 004 slide 0xbe2c000 = 0 and 005 slide 0xc790000 = 0.

Reran test_kc_layout.py independently with the same three artifacts: 3/3 OK, HOST_LAYOUT_CHECKS_PASSED, hashes identical to runs/m1-bringup-009/kc-layout-check-001.log. Scope note: that test models only the __TEXT/__DATA_CONST pair; C5 covers all prot_init requests.
normal_image.inspect rejects the old KC ('Embedded kernel TEXT overlaps writable startup DATA_CONST') and accepts the control KC.

residual_note.severity: low, permission-neutral, unchanged by the fix
residual_note.finding: In 144/2048 phases (7.0%), in BOTH KCs, the upstream RWNX+HINT mapping of the gap between __PRELINK_TEXT end and kernel __TEXT (0xfffffe0006b58000..0xfffffe0007004000 linked) contains __PRELINK_INFO (0xfffffe0006b58000+0x24000), which upstream then remaps RWNX without HINT. Permissions and attributes are identical, so this cannot cause a permission fault like attempt-005. It is still a mixed contiguous-bit group (CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE: a TLB conflict abort is possible in principle). The code path is upstream XNU arm_vm_prot_init and its occurrence depends on the fileset layout. Kernel owner may consider it later; not a blocker for this fix.
